mission: A nonprofit giving free career advice, now focused mainly on AI: problem profiles (loss of control, extreme power concentration, gradual disempowerment), AI career reviews (technical safety, governance, security, field-building), a job board, 1-1 advising and the long-running 80,000 Hours Podcast. It is donor-funded and takes no ads or corporate sponsorship. CEO: Niel Bowerman; co-founders Benjamin Todd and Will MacAskill.

key_work.title: Problem profile: Risks from advanced artificial intelligence
key_work.plain_summary: Their flagship case that AI risks are potentially catastrophic, approaching quickly and under-addressed.

key_work.title: AI safety technical research career review
key_work.plain_summary: Guide to whether and how to become a technical AI safety researcher.

key_work.title: 80,000 Hours Podcast (AI episodes)
key_work.plain_summary: Multi-hour interviews with leading AI safety researchers at Google DeepMind, Anthropic, METR, Redwood, Apollo and others.

key_work.title: 80,000 Hours Job Board
key_work.plain_summary: Curated listings of high-impact roles, heavily weighted to AI safety and governance.

warnings.text: AI risks are 'potentially catastrophic and approaching quickly — and not enough is being done about them' (homepage).
Companies are racing to build advanced AI while governments 'can hardly keep up — so the window to influence its trajectory might be closing'.

recommendations.text: More people should pay attention and try to steer AI development for the better while curtailing the worst risks (homepage).
Choose careers in AI safety research, governance, security or field-building; or help through advocacy, political engagement and donations if you can't switch jobs.
